title: Video upload and streaming
prompt: Design a video platform where users upload videos and others stream them on any device, anywhere in the world.
hard_part: Huge files, global delivery, processing pipeline
key_points: Sent uploads straight to object storage with pre-signed, resumable multipart uploads
Built processing as an async pipeline: split into segments, transcode in parallel into several renditions, package manifests
Made workers stateless and idempotent, with a workflow engine retrying failed tasks
Served playback with adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS/DASH) from a CDN
Used numbers to show that bandwidth and storage dominate cost, and covered CDN tiers and hot content
Recovered stuck or abandoned uploads, with the metadata status as the source of truth
